functions.name: config.check_control_override_successor
config.guard_control_override_history
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION config.guard_control_override_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.scope_level='control_version' AND OLD.lifecycle_state IN ('approved','rejected') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'decided override immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; ELSE RETURN NEW; END IF;
END $function$

functions.name: knowledge.check_context_link
knowledge.enforce_source_usage_rights
knowledge.guard_context_link
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION knowledge.guard_context_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE rec record;
BEGIN
 -- Lock source(s) in canonical order; check BOTH parents on attempted reparenting.
 FOR rec IN SELECT knowledge_version_id,lifecycle_state,published_at FROM knowledge.knowledge_versions
 WHERE knowledge_version_id IN (CASE WHEN TG_OP<>'DELETE' THEN NEW.knowledge_version_id END,CASE WHEN TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN OLD.knowledge_version_id END)
 ORDER BY knowledge_version_id FOR UPDATE LOOP
  IF rec.published_at IS NOT NULL OR rec.lifecycle_state='published' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'published knowledge links immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; ELSE RETURN NEW; END IF;
END $function$

functions.name: knowledge.guard_context_target_owner
knowledge.guard_published_version_core
regulatory.guard_context_decision_history
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION regulatory.guard_context_decision_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.lifecycle_state<>'draft' AND NEW.context_knowledge_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.context_knowledge_version_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'decided context immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

constraint.name: ck_configuration_definitions__typed_default
constraint.definition:
CHECK ((((value_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['boolean'::character varying, 'integer'::character varying, 'decimal'::character varying, 'text'::character varying, 'timestamp'::character varying, 'duration'::character varying, 'json'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((num_nonnulls(default_boolean_value, default_integer_value, default_decimal_value, default_text_value, default_timestamp_value, default_duration_seconds_value, default_json_value) = 0) OR ((num_nonnulls(default_boolean_value, default_integer_value, default_decimal_value, default_text_value, default_timestamp_value, default_duration_seconds_value, default_json_value) = 1) AND
CASE value_type
    WHEN 'boolean'::text THEN (default_boolean_value IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'integer'::text THEN (default_integer_value IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'decimal'::text THEN (default_decimal_value IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'text'::text THEN (default_text_value IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'timestamp'::text THEN (default_timestamp_value IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'duration'::text THEN (default_duration_seconds_value IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'json'::text THEN (default_json_value IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE false
END))))
